decision_conditions: <p>Noise from proposed ASHP's/ AC Unit to which the application refers shall not exceed a level 5 dB(A) below the existing representative LA90(15min) background noise level at any time when the plant is operating and where the source is tonal it shall not exceed 10 dB(A) below the background noise described above. The noise emitted shall be measured or predicted at 1.0m from the facade of the nearest residential premises habitable room window or at 1.2m above any adjacent residential garden, terrace, balcony or patio.</p><p>Reason: To safeguard the amenities of neighbouring occupiers.&nbsp;</p>
application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: FAST TRACK -Partial demolition of the existing side addition and two-storey rear outrigger,Construction of a single-storey rear and side extension, Reconfiguration and enlargement of the existing two-storey rear outrigger, including the formation of a double-pitched roof , Reconstruction of the existing side addition, including new single and double-pitched roof forms, Construction of a rear dormer roof extension and loft conversion, Installation of rooflights to the front and rear roof slopes, Replacement of all existing windows, Installation of a domestic air-source heat pump, Construction of a timber double-pitched porch canopy , Alterations to the side fenestration and side door position, Installation of tile cladding to the existing front bay
